title: quiet-bridge: staged reconciliation for A/B canaries and cohort coherency
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Adds a new 'quiet bridge' staged reconciliation path for A/B canaries that improves cohort coherency during progressive promotions and reduces noisy rollbacks. Backwards compatible; feature gated by rollout policy flag.
description: Context: we observed two classes of failures during multi-arm A/B canaries: (1) transient cohort divergence when clients hit a promoted model variant out-of-order, and (2) excessive rollback oscillation from noisy short-window metrics. Motivation: reduce operational churn and customer-facing regressions by decoupling immediate traffic promotion from cohort state convergence. This PR introduces the 'quiet bridge' — a staged reconciliation bridge that sits between shadow -> canary -> promoted paths. Design summary: the bridge buffers canonical session keys and exposure metadata for a configurable reconciliation window (default 60s), performs probabilistic replay/forwarding to lagging cohorts, and applies an entropy-annealing policy to avoid sudden distributional shifts. Safety gates: metric thresholds (latency/err-rate/fidelity delta) are evaluated on both promoted traffic and replayed cohort traffic before final promotion commit. The bridge exposes observability hooks (per-cohort exposure histogram, reconciliation lag, replay QPS) and integrates with existing rollout decision graph via a Reconcile step. Feature flags & rollout: disabled by default; a rollout policy flag (rollout.reconciliation.quiet_bridge=true) enables it per-route. Rollout plan: staged internal rollout to 10% tenants, then 50%, then global over 4 weeks, with automatic rollback if reconciliation lag > 2m or fidelity delta > 3x baseline. Checklist: - [x] core runtime: buffer store + reconciler loop - [x] routing: conditional forwarders and replay edges - [x] policy: entropy annealing schedule + safety gate checks - [x] metrics: histograms, counters, tracing spans - [x] e2e integration tests and simulation harness - [x] docs & operator guide - [x] feature flag gating Behavior with failing nodes: bridge falls back to immediate forward if reconcilers are degraded; we record a 'bridge-bypassed' metric for postmortem. Backwards compatibility: all existing rollout graphs run unchanged when the feature flag is off. Tests: unit tests for buffer eviction, property-based tests for entropy annealing monotonicity, integration test simulating out-of-order session arrivals (added to perf-canary suite). Risks & mitigations: - Increased memory usage for buffering (mitigated via per-tenant sizing + TTL) - Potential replay amplification (mitigated via rate limiter and probabilistic sampling) - Complexity in debugging (mitigated via detailed tracing spanning reconciliation steps). Related work: references ENG-2145 (cohort convergence study) and ENG-2201 (rollback oscillation investigation). TL;DR: merges a self-contained reconciliation bridge that reduces false-positive rollbacks and smooths cohort promotions for A/B and canary rollouts.

Luca: I pushed a small change to make the annealing schedule linear by default; we can change to sigmoid later if needed. Diego: observed a flaky test in integration runs — fixed timeout and added deterministic RNG seed for property tests. Luca: approved once CI green and e2e sims pass.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2026-03-02 by Priya Kapoor. Commit message: feat(reconciler): add quiet bridge staged reconciliation for A/B canaries; includes metrics, tests, docs. No post-merge blockers reported. Monitoring: staged rollout started for 10% tenants via feature flag. Observability playbook updated; incident runbook reference ENG-2145 added.
notes_for_release: Operator opt-in via rollout.reconciliation.quiet_bridge; default TTL 60s and per-tenant buffer size 64 sessions. Recommend enabling in staging first and watching reconciliation_lag_seconds and reconciliation_replays_total. If bridge_bypassed_total spikes, investigate reconciler pod connectivity.
testing_instructions: Run go test ./runtime/reconciler -run TestBufferEviction && run perf-canary simulation ab_out_of_order_test --seed=42. Deploy to staging with rollout.reconciliation.quiet_bridge=true for a single small tenant and observe metrics for 15m.
migration_notes: No DB migrations. Config toggle only. Operators can adjust rollout.reconciliation.buffer_ttl_seconds and buffer_size_per_tenant. Backwards compatible when flag off.
post_merge_followups: (1) Observability drill: add dashboard for reconciliation_lag percentiles (ENG-2240) (2) Run 2-week canary on 50% tenant cohort and evaluate rollback rate delta (ENG-2241)

risk_assessment: Medium: added runtime component introduces operational surface but is feature-gated and includes throttles/TTL. Memory and replay amplification are primary risks but mitigations included.
support_notes: Support teams: if a customer reports session mismatch during promote, check 'reconciliation_lag_seconds' and 'bridge_bypassed_total'. If traffic seems delayed, verify reconciler pod health and feature flag state.
